description:
Zero-dependency resilience library for .NET 7/8/9. Provides Retry (with jitter/backoff),
            Circuit Breaker (sliding-window state machine), Timeout (optimistic + pessimistic),
            Fallback, Bulkhead, Rate Limiter (partitioned per-user/IP), Hedge, and Chaos policies via a fluent builder API.
            Attach policies to Vali-Mediator requests via IResiliencePolicyProvider<T> (no class needed),
            with global fallback policy support. No Polly or other external dependencies required.
releaseNotes:
v1.2.4 — Tests for auto-discovery:
            - Unit tests for RegisterResiliencePoliciesFromAssemblyContaining<T>() and RegisterResiliencePoliciesFromAssembly(): provider discovery, default Scoped lifetime, lifetime override, null argument guards, and policy validity.
            - Total test count: 87 → 97.

            v1.2.3 — Auto-discovery for IResiliencePolicyProvider<T>:
            - RegisterResiliencePoliciesFromAssemblyContaining<T>(): auto-discovers and registers all policy providers.
            - RegisterResiliencePoliciesFromAssembly(assembly, lifetime): explicit assembly variant.
            Eliminates manual AddResiliencePolicyProvider<T,P>() calls for each provider class.

            v1.2.2 — Bug fix: ResilienceBehavior now caches the resolved ResiliencePolicy per request type using a
            static field (one cache slot per TRequest+TResponse combination). This covers both AddResiliencePolicy<T>
            lambdas and class-based IResiliencePolicyProvider<T> providers. Stateful policies (Circuit Breaker,
            Rate Limiter, Bulkhead, Hedge) now correctly preserve their state across all requests of the same type,
            regardless of behavior lifetime or provider implementation.

            v1.2.1 — Bug fix: DelegateResiliencePolicyProvider now caches the built ResiliencePolicy after the first request,
            matching the behavior of a static provider. Previously the lambda was invoked on every call, causing
            stateful policies (Circuit Breaker, Rate Limiter, Bulkhead, Hedge) to lose their state between requests.

            v1.2.0 — Policy providers & partitioned rate limiting:
            - IResiliencePolicyProvider<TRequest>: declare policies in a separate class, keeping commands clean.
            - services.AddResiliencePolicy<T>(lambda): inline registration without a class.
            - services.AddResiliencePolicyProvider<T,TProvider>(): class-based registration for DI-dependent providers.
            - IGlobalResiliencePolicyProvider / services.AddGlobalResiliencePolicy(): fallback policy for all requests.
            - RateLimiterOptions.PartitionKeyResolver: per-user/IP rate limiting via a key selector func.
            - IResilient marked [Obsolete] — use AddResiliencePolicy<T>() instead.

            v1.1.0 — Package structure: now uses Vali-Mediator as NuGet dependency instead of local ProjectReference.

            v1.0.1 — Documentation: enabled XML documentation file for full IntelliSense support.

            v1.0.0 — Initial release:
            - RetryPolicy: Fixed / Linear / Exponential / ExponentialWithJitter / Custom backoff, per-exception and per-ErrorType conditions, OnRetry callback.
            - CircuitBreakerPolicy: sliding-window failure tracking, Closed → Open → HalfOpen state machine, configurable thresholds, callbacks.
            - TimeoutPolicy: Optimistic (CancellationToken) and Pessimistic (Task.WhenAny) strategies.
            - FallbackPolicy: typed fallback value or factory, conditional activation, OnFallback callback.
            - BulkheadPolicy: semaphore-based concurrency limiter with optional queue, OnRejected callback.
            - ResiliencePolicy: composable fluent builder combining all policies.
            - ResiliencePresets: ForExternalApi, ForDatabase, ForCritical, NoResilience.
            - Vali-Mediator integration: IResilient interface + ResilienceBehavior pipeline.
            - CircuitBreakerRegistry: keyed singleton registry for sharing circuit state across calls.
